parts.script:
Sarah: Hey, Mark! Do you have any plans for the weekend? 
Mark: Not really. I was thinking about a little getaway, maybe to the countryside. What about you? 
Sarah: That sounds nice! I’ve been wanting to visit that new hiking trail. 
Mark: Oh, I’ve heard about it! It has some stunning views. We could pack a picnic and make a day of it. 
Sarah: Great idea! Do you think we should invite anyone else? 
Mark: How about inviting Lucy? She loves hiking. 
Sarah: Good call! I’ll text her. Do you think we should leave early in the morning? 
Mark: Yeah, if we leave by 7, we can avoid the traffic and have more time to explore. 
Sarah: Perfect! I’ll bring sandwiches and snacks. What about drinks? 
Mark: I can take care of that. I’ll bring some water and juice. 
Sarah: Awesome! Can’t wait! 
Mark: Me too! It's going to be a fun adventure!

questions.explanation: They are planning a hiking day trip to the countryside.

questions.explanation: They plan to leave by 7 AM to avoid traffic.

questions.explanation: Mark agrees to bring water and juice.
